_comment: Dated catalysts. Every entry needs a date, a source, and a 'so_what' naming what it changes in the book. An event with no so_what is news, not a catalyst, and does not belong here. Types: policy, trade, legal, earnings, monetary, political, corporate.

events.title: US-China rare-earth truce expiry
events.so_what: The single largest dated risk in the book. Dixon, auto, and every magnet-dependent manufacturer reprice on the outcome. India is a price-taker here with no seat at the table. HEDGING NOTE 2026-08-27: index put protection at this tenor is NOT PURCHASABLE -- the 23-Nov chain lists no strike near 10% OTM and the lowest listed (22,450) has zero open interest and no bid. Size down or reduce the specific exposure; do not plan on puts. Re-check the November chain in early October.

events.title: Cluster of US trade-policy deadlines
events.so_what: Identified as the concentration point of the Washington-exposure finding. Multiple India-relevant instruments land within a week of each other.

events.title: Jio IPO listing deadline (self-imposed by the thesis)
events.so_what: Written invalidation for BOTH reliance-2026-08-25 and bharti-2026-08-26. As of 27 Aug: no SEBI observation letter, no price band, no date. The deadline is mine, not the company's.

events.title: India-EU FTA signing (legal scrub complete 27 Aug 2026)
events.so_what: Does NOT exempt India from CBAM. Steel takes a 15-22% price hit, aluminium exports already down 41%. An FTA headline will be read as bullish for metals and it is not.

events.title: NTPC CMD vacancy — written invalidation if unfilled
events.so_what: Manual condition on the NTPC decades thesis. A regulated utility running without a confirmed CMD past a full quarter is a governance signal, not an administrative delay.

events.title: Q2 FY27 results season begins
events.so_what: The test of the 4.5% FY26 growth number against 12-15% expected. NOTE: the 'nine straight years of misses' framing is RETIRED as unsourced -- what is real and dated is a ~9% cumulative FY27 EPS downgrade cycle through spring 2026 that has since turned, with Q1 FY27 PAT reported +18% YoY. That +18% collides with an '+18%' this base already corrected once and may not be used until its provenance is separated.

events.title: Union Budget FY28
events.so_what: Budget-day risk for every position. NOTE: the Feb 2026 STT hike is ALREADY IN FORCE as of today -- it was dated as a future event in an earlier draft of this file and it is not. Hedge costs quoted in this workspace are post-hike costs. Do not discount them again for a change that has already happened.

watching_undated.title: Senate Russia sanctions bill — 100% tariff threat on India, passed Senate 86-11, House pending
watching_undated.so_what: Russia is now >50% of India's crude imports. This is the largest single undated tail risk to the entire index, not to one sector.

watching_undated.title: White House Tier-1 transshipment designation for India — designated, no action yet
watching_undated.so_what: The designation is the precondition for action, not the action. Watch for the instrument, not the label.

watching_undated.title: H-1B rule finalisation / HIRE Act revival
watching_undated.so_what: Written invalidation-adjacent condition on the Infosys bench. I had framed IT risk as AI disruption; it is at least as much US trade policy.

watching_undated.title: ICICI Bank CEO reappointment contested to RBI, escalated 24 Aug
watching_undated.so_what: Manual review condition on the largest short-horizon position.

watching_undated.title: CBI Ramagundam FIR — whether NTPC personnel are formally named
watching_undated.so_what: Manual review condition on the decades thesis.

watching_undated.title: House vote on the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026 (Senate passed 86-11, 7 Aug)
watching_undated.so_what:
CORRECTED 2026-08-29: I had logged a 31 Aug House vote as a T+2 dated catalyst. It does not survive fresher sourcing. Co-sponsor Blumenthal, speaking 26 Aug -- three days ago -- expects a vote in SEPTEMBER, not 31 Aug. The House does return to session on 31 Aug but the bill is not on the announced floor schedule. Back to undated.
AND THE TAIL IS SMALLER THAN I THOUGHT: the bill grants the President BROAD WAIVER AUTHORITY -- sanctions and tariffs can be waived on certification to Congress that it is in the national interest. So House passage does NOT mechanically mean 100% tariffs on India; it creates an authority, not an outcome. A House companion introduced 10-11 Aug by McCaul and Hoyer is described even by The Hill as symbolic rather than the vehicle.
